r. 9th cl. (उध्रस्नाति) r. 10th cl. (उध्रामयति)
1 To glean or gather by little at a time.
2 To throw or cast upwards. The initial उ is considered^1 by some as an indicatory letter, the root being then ध्रस; q. v.
[1] Correction submitted by Dr. Sampada Savardekar on 20210731. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/csl-corrections/issues/66.
